## Look

kind: commands. Run `dashboard/bin/web` against a store and open the UI: Home, Journal, a phase overlay with its tabs, a task overlay, and the confirm dialog, in light and dark. Run `cd dashboard/frontend && npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run build`.

## Machine

- Acceptances: every active ui-structure acceptance passes at 368cadb61f99a0469e94568882618742c1e2ba2a (orchestra check).
- Review: PASS at 368cadb61f99a0469e94568882618742c1e2ba2a (subject ui-structure-review). Integration-report: pass.
- Suite: 268, 134, 1242 tests pass per leg at 368cadb61f99a0469e94568882618742c1e2ba2a; the last leg (pytest -m tmux) exits 5. Advisory gate.

## Attention

- A human must look at the restyled UI: run dashboard/bin/web and open every screen (Home, Journal, phase and task overlays, the confirm dialog) in light and dark. jsdom tests cannot check layout or look.
- deepLinks.test.ts changed by one import line (finding ui-structure-r12-deeplinks-pin); the hash is re-pinned.
- After the confirm dialog closes, focus lands on the detail dialog's Back button, not on the Approve opener.
- A human must drop the tmux pass from the suite command in .canon/config.json (finding suite-command-tmux-pass).
- The shared-helpers phase edits dashboard files on unmerged branches; its merge needs hand resolution across the moves.
